messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: sustained high latency and request queuing for dedicated pool ap-south-1 serving Meridian Labs. Observed queue length > 200 and p95 latency doubling since 13:10 UTC. Paging @Priya Nair (on-call) @Ben Ortiz @Tao Zhang
Priya Nair (on-call): I'm on-call. Looking at autoscaler and pod metrics. Any deploys in last 30m?
Ben Ortiz: No deploys. Autoscaler shows rapid scale down events around 13:05-13:07, then failed scale-ups due to kube-scheduler pending. Node provisioning lagging (spot interruptions?).
Tao Zhang: Spot termination events in ap-south-1 at 13:02-13:08. Several nodes reclaimed, autoscaler attempted to replace them but new nodes stuck in provisioning for ~6m due to cloud quota throttling.
Priya Nair (on-call): Ok. Immediate mitigation: pause autoscaler for Meridian Labs' nodegroup and schedule a manual scale-up to restore headroom. Also set max_concurrency lower for their routes to reduce queue.
Ben Ortiz: Executing: `kubectl scale --replicas=8 deployment/meridian-dedicated -n redwood-workloads` and `redwoodctl autoscaler suspend --nodegroup ap-south-1-ded`
Ben Ortiz: Also increasing emergency capacity by adding dedicated fallback nodes in ap-south-2: `infractl create-nodepool --region ap-south-2 --size g5.xlarge --purpose fallback-meridian`
Lina - CS: Pulling Meridian Labs contact routing. Primary contacts:
- ops@meridianlabs.ai (Jin Morales)
- platform@meridianlabs.ai (Dr. Saira Khan)
- legal@meridianlabs.ai (Compliance)
Routing: Pager -> email -> slack #meridian-labs-escalations
I'll prep a short customer note once we confirm impact window.
Priya Nair (on-call): Suggested customer-safe message: 
"Meridian team - we're investigating increased latency for your dedicated inference in AP-South. Engineers are provisioning capacity and temporarily limiting concurrency to stabilize requests. You may experience slower responses. We'll update in 20 minutes or on significant change."
Tao Zhang: Provisioning completed for fallback nodes, but kube-scheduler backlog persists until new nodes join cluster. Kernel logs show kubelet failing due to CNI plugin rate limits, likely a control-plane API throttling from many spot churn events.
Ben Ortiz: Workaround applied: bump CNI init parallelism and increase node join retry: `kubectl set env daemonset/cni-handler -n kube-system JOIN_PARALLEL=30 JOIN_RETRY=12`
Ben Ortiz: Manually drained and replaced stuck pods. Reinstated 6 replicas. Queue length dropped from 220 -> 40 in ~4 mins. p95 latency trending down from 820ms -> 310ms.
Statuspage Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0927-07 - Capacity and provisioning issues causing elevated latency for Meridian Labs (ap-south-1). Visibility: partial outage. Public updates scheduled every 20m.
Priya Nair (on-call): Internal comms template for execs: 
"Impact: Meridian Labs experienced elevated request queuing and latency due to spot node churn and cloud quota throttling in ap-south-1. Mitigation: suspended autoscaler, scaled dedicated replicas manually, provisioned fallback nodes in ap-south-2, adjusted CNI join parallelism. Customer impact: degraded latency and queued requests between 13:05-13:35 UTC. Owners: postmortem Ben Ortiz; customer comms Lina. Next steps: capacity audit for ap-south-1, reduce reliance on spot nodes for enterprise pools, add autoscaler fail-safe for manual capacity."
Lina - CS: I'll send customer update now with the suggested wording. Also note SLA window and offer to coordinate postmortem.
Ben Ortiz: Monitoring: queue now < 20, p95 latency ~260ms. No 5xx increase. Autoscaler still suspended for safety.
Priya Nair (on-call): Runbook note - when node provisioning delayed >3m, we should run emergency_scale to a standby nodepool. I'll file a runbook change after this incident. Command to collect provisioning logs: `infractl logs nodepool ap-south-1-ded --since 20m`
Tao Zhang: Observed related API throttling errors in cloud provider responses. Filing cloud support ticket for quota throttle spike.
Lina - CS: Customer message (sent): "We detected elevated latency for your dedicated inference in AP-South beginning ~13:05 UTC. Our engineers provisioned additional capacity and temporarily limited concurrency; performance is improving. We'll follow up with a detailed timeline and remediation steps. Contact: ops@meridianlabs.ai." Customer replied: "Thanks, please keep us posted and confirm SLA impact"
Priya Nair (on-call): SLA note: capture timeframe 13:05-13:35 UTC for credits discussion. Lina, include that in post-incident follow-up.
Ben Ortiz: Suggestion for remediation: convert enterprise pools in ap-south-1 off spot by default or keep a small warm pool of on-demand nodes (headroom >= 30%). Opened infra ticket INFRA-4523.
Statuspage Bot: Public update posted: "Mitigation in progress: additional capacity provisioned and autoscaler suspended for targeted pools. Engineers monitoring. Next update in 20 minutes."
Tao Zhang: After 13:30, nodes stable; no further spot churn. Proposing gradual re-enable of autoscaler with conservative cooldowns. `redwoodctl autoscaler resume --nodegroup ap-south-1-ded --cooldown 600`
Ben Ortiz: Resumed autoscaler with cooldown 600s and min_replicas=6. Observability: steady state reached, p95 ~210ms.
Priya Nair (on-call): Marking incident state: mitigated pending postmortem. Can we capture exact list of remedial commands for the postmortem?
Ben Ortiz: Collected commands used in thread. Will include them in postmortem notes.
Lina - CS: Sending customer follow-up with timeline and offer for postmortem meeting and SLA credit process.
Exec Ops Bot: Flagging for capacity review in weekly ops sync and notifying platform head.
Priya Nair (on-call): Handing off to Ben for postmortem. Ben, please include root cause, timeline, remediation (nodepool config changes, autoscaler safe-guard), and customer-facing summary. Target postmortem draft: 2026-09-29 EOD.
Ben Ortiz: Will own postmortem. Adding runbook updates and INFRA-4523 follow-up.
Lina - CS: Customer acknowledged follow-up and asked for ETA on permanent fix. I'll coordinate with Ben and Tao for dates.
Priya Nair (on-call): Closing thread for paging. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
